brief: Paris -> Brussels -> Amsterdam, 5 days (arrive Sun 3 Jan 2027, fly out Thu 7 Jan). Two travelers, one room. Budget 900 EUR all-in for food + tickets + local transport + the two train legs; hotels separate. Style: walkable days, museums before 11, one food stop per day, nothing booked the night before we land.

day in the capital, evening train to Amsterdam
